body:
closes https://github.com/CliMA/ClimaCalibrate.jl/issues/344 - This PR adds lazy diagonal terms (that are computed with `compute_diagonal`) to support custom diagonal terms for the `SVDplusDCovariance` observation recipe. This allows the users to write more flexible diagonal terms for the `SVDplusDCovariance` observation recipe which are needed for the calibration experiments.

With the diagonal terms, the `covariance` functions are rewritten to reuse the diagonal terms instead of duplicating the code between the different covariance estimators.
title: Add diagonal term for `SVDPlusDCovariance` observation recipe
